verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox documents SDKs and a CLI for agentic workflows that programmatically create sandboxes, run commands in blocking or detached mode, stream logs, and manage files. Authentication is automatic in production, so an agent can provision a sandbox, execute code and read the output without a human. Teardown is covered by the configurable timeout (default 5 minutes), but the only documented explicit stop is a Dashboard click. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented programmatic stop/delete call in the SDK or CLI, documentation of how command exit codes and stdout are returned, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully autonomous end-to-end loop.
